name: AutoTradeProject_ImplementationQuality_Orchestrator_v0_1
display_name: Auto Trade Project Implementation Quality Orchestrator v0.1
purpose: Run one approved implementation unit through test-first design, minimal implementation, local verification, bounded debugging, independent review, and a Human Gate without replacing existing project or implementation-design orchestrators.
bootstrap_quality_gate_scope: scripts/quality_gate and tests/quality_gate only; extending the allowlist to a Phase implementation unit requires a separately approved component update.
phase_scope_policy: A Run ID must be registered before execution; the registry fixes scope_mode, target paths, excluded paths, fixture checksum, baseline ref, and four command templates. For scope_mode=target_only, unrelated HEAD/worktree paths are not used to decide the test target or change hash; only registered target paths are inspected. The manifest is comparison input, not an execution policy.
trigger_examples: Run Manifest を入力として Phase 2 の一機能をテスト先行で実装して
AutoTradeProject_ImplementationQuality_Orchestrator_v0_1 で品質ゲートを実行して
workflow_policy: Require an approved design and a complete Run Manifest before any implementation.
Run A110 before A120 and require a valid RED result before implementation.
Run only the local command templates in the trusted scope registry; never use a shell or network command.
Require host outbound isolation confirmation before a phase test subprocess; otherwise return BLOCKED.
On a failed local gate, use A140 and allow at most two attempts for the same root-cause hypothesis.
Require A150 and A160 reviews after local gates pass; Critical or High findings return the unit.
Require an explicit user approval declaration matching the run_id before PASS or Phase handoff; do not require signature keys or an external approval channel.
Persist sanitized evidence only below test/evidence/{phase_id}/{run_id}/.
stop_conditions: Missing required Run Manifest fields or an evidence path outside test/evidence.
Unknown, Secret, Broker, Live-trading, external network, or project-external path detection.
Test deletion, skip-based pass, quality-threshold weakening, or an allowlist violation.
A repeated root-cause hypothesis exceeds two attempts.
Critical or High review finding remains, or the user has not explicitly approved the Run.
